# Ending Support in 2023 - Microsoft Lifecycle | Microsoft Learn

![](/en-us/lifecycle/media/search.png) Please go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/products/) to search for your product's lifecycle.

The following list represents products retiring or reaching the end of support in 2023. Upon retirement or end of support, there will be no new security updates, non-security updates, free or paid assisted support options or online technical content updates. Go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/overview/product-end-of-support-overview) to learn about Fixed and Modern Lifecycle policies and service packs.

If you have any questions regarding support for a product, please contact your Microsoft Account Representative. If you need technical support, visit the [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/contactus/?ws=support) website.

## Product Retirements

The following products, governed by the [Modern Policy](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/modern), will retire in 2023.

| Product | Retirement |
| --- | --- |
| [Visio Services in SharePoint (in Microsoft 365)](/en-us/lifecycle/products/visio-services-in-sharepoint-in-microsoft-365?branch=live) | February 10, 2023 |
| [Microsoft Store for Business and Education](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-store-for-business-and-education?branch=live) | March 31, 2023 |
| [Kaizala](/en-us/lifecycle/products/kaizala?branch=live) | August 31, 2023 |
| [Microsoft Azure Virtual Machine (classic)](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-azure-virtual-machine-classic?branch=live)[Scheduler for Microsoft 365](/en-us/lifecycle/products/scheduler-for-microsoft-365?branch=live) | September 1, 2023 |

## Products moving to Extended Support

The following products will be moving from Mainstream to Extended Support in 2023. Extended Support includes security updates at no cost, and paid non-security updates and support. Additionally, Microsoft will not accept requests for design changes or new features during the Extended Support phase.

| Product | End of Mainstream Support |
| --- | --- |
| [Dynamics GP 2018](/en-us/lifecycle/products/dynamics-gp-2018?branch=live)[Dynamics GP 2018 R2](/en-us/lifecycle/products/dynamics-gp-2018-r2?branch=live)[Dynamics NAV 2018](/en-us/lifecycle/products/dynamics-nav-2018?branch=live)[Visual Studio Team Foundation Server 2018](/en-us/lifecycle/products/visual-studio-team-foundation-server-2018?branch=live) | January 10, 2023 |
| [Access 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/access-2019?branch=live)[Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Fixed Policy)](/en-us/lifecycle/products/dynamics-365-business-central-onpremises-fixed-policy?branch=live)[Excel 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/excel-2019?branch=live)[Microsoft Office 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/microsoft-office-2019?branch=live)[OneNote 2016](/en-us/lifecycle/products/onenote-2016?branch=live)[Outlook 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/outlook-2019?branch=live)[PowerPoint 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/powerpoint-2019?branch=live)[Project 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/project-2019?branch=live)[Publisher 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/publisher-2019?branch=live)[Visio 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/visio-2019?branch=live)[Word 2019](/en-us/lifecycle/products/word-2019?branch=live) | October 10, 2023 |
